Seven models (M01, M02, M03, M07, M08, M09, M10) gave identical predictions at every seed; only M04, M05 and M06 varied. These values are a diagnostic, not a noise floor. Chi-square is at its maximum, N(k-1) = 45, because all five repeats rank the ten models identically. The Iman-Davenport F is infinite in the limit and its p-value is 0.
